svg.title: Your monitors, ready when you are.
svg.desc: Illustrated extended monitor switching with real Windows and Mac desktop imagery. The extended Windows screen covers the local Mac applications and Dock. The shortcut switches back to the Mac; the Remote page shows Switched away. The original Show action restores the connected screen. Actual v2.4.0 Remote captures use sample devices. Timing is illustrative.
svg.text: Your monitors, ready when you are.
A faster first start. Screens stay above what is already open.
Use the Show button in Remote.
Actual app UI with sample computers. Desktop switching is illustrated.
